d: I think there are a lot of you out there, whether you’re looking to join the military or are already serving and thinking about changing specialties, that are very much considering joining the infantry… but you’re having a hard time making up your mind. So, I thought it would be a good idea to give you my on opinions and insights based on my own experience as an infantryman. Let me know if this was helpful to you and if you have any questions ask away in the comments, I’ll get back to you!
